### Requirements for `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-p-frontend-shell-dashboard-and-notifications.md`
1. Header metadata:
   ```markdown
   # Feature: P2-P — Frontend Shell, Dashboard & In-App Notifications

   Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features
   Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md
   Story: P2-P
   Surfaces: frontend
   Material: no
   ```
2. `## User story` — exact one-sentence user story from `P2-P` row in `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`.
3. `## Acceptance criteria` — `AC-1` through `AC-8` (8 scenarios matching `Size: 8`), each with `### AC-n — <name>`, `Kind: happy | negative | edge`, `Given`, `When`, `Then` (with observable DOM/UI/HTTP outcomes; no vague phrases like "works as expected", "handles errors gracefully", or "successfully processes"):
   - `AC-1` (`Kind: happy`): Render the GCash-tokenized portal application shell and authenticate or restore the operator session via `/api/v1/auth/session` (or local mock/OIDC sign-in when unauthenticated), keeping session state in memory without storing tokens or secrets in `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` (`frontend-web.mdc`, `security-baseline.mdc` §4), and supporting clean sign-out (`POST /api/v1/auth/logout`).
   - `AC-2` (`Kind: happy`): Render dynamic navigation menus filtered by the authenticated principal's active permission set (`permissions` / `effectivePermissions` from `/api/v1/auth/session`), exposing authorized workspaces (Dashboard, Report Execution, Configuration & Reference Data, Governance Ticketing, IAM & Audit) and redirecting zero-role principals (`roles: []`) to the self-service "Role Apply" onboarding landing view (`roadmap` Now: Self-Service Onboarding).
   - `AC-3` (`Kind: happy`): Render the Dashboard UI backed by `GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets` displaying the five operational widgets (`myOpenRuns` / `my_open_runs`, `recentRuns` / `recent_runs`, `myTodoCount` / `my_todo_count`, `awaitingApproval` / `awaiting_approval`, and `failedScheduledJobs` / `failed_scheduled_jobs`) with explicit loading, populated, and empty-state placeholders when counts/lists are zero.
   - `AC-4` (`Kind: happy`): Render the in-app Notification Bell badge and slide-over drawer backed by `GET /api/v1/notifications`, supporting unread filter (`unreadOnly`), opening a notification (`GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}` / navigating to `linkPath`), and marking individual or all notifications as read (`POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`).
   - `AC-5` (`Kind: happy`): Propagate `X-Correlation-ID` and `traceparent` headers on outbound `/api/v1/**` requests (`credentials: 'include'`) and surface an accessible RFC 7807 Problem Detail modal (`role="alertdialog"`) displaying `title`, `status`, `detail`, `errorCode`, and copyable `correlationId` whenever an API call returns an `application/problem+json` error (such as `409`, `422`, `500`, or `503 SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE`).
   - `AC-6` (`Kind: edge`): Keyboard accessibility, focus management, reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion`), and XSS-safe rendering across the shell, notification bell drawer, and RFC 7807 problem detail modal (escaping untrusted strings in notification subjects/bodies and RFC 7807 `detail` without `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, trapping focus inside open modal/drawer, closing on `Escape`, and restoring focus to the trigger button).
   - `AC-7` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse unauthorized workspace navigation and block mutating notification actions (`POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`) when an active administrative `View-As` read-only overlay (`readOnlyOverlay: true` / `effectiveViewAsRole` in session claims) is active or when the backend refuses with `HTTP 403 Forbidden` (`errorCode = "VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN"` or `"AUTH_FORBIDDEN"`), displaying the active `View-As` read-only indicator/banner and surfacing the RFC 7807 refusal modal with `correlationId`.
   - `AC-8` (`Kind: negative`): Refuse unauthenticated or expired-session API responses (`HTTP 401 Unauthorized` with `errorCode = "AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED"` or `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable` with `errorCode = "SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE"` on fail-closed Redis outage) by clearing in-memory session state, preventing protected workspace rendering, and transitioning to the sign-in / fail-closed session error view with the RFC 7807 `correlationId`.
